heroTitle: Find the Right Work. Find the Right Workforce.
heroDescription: LabourLink AI connects daily-wage workers with construction contractors through structured job discovery and workforce matching.
matchingRules: Matching uses clear rules: skill, location and availability. Workers are ranked by experience.
skillMatchingText: Jobs list the skill needed. Workers are matched by skill.
locationWorkText: Find jobs in your area, such as Benz Circle, Vijayawada.
workerAvailabilityText: Only workers marked available are shown to contractors.
workforceManagementText: Contractors post jobs and see eligible workers in one place.
